Frequently asked questions
What is a Bespoke SIM-Only plan from M1?

M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plans are affordable, flexible, contract-free 5G mobile plans starting and they offer generous local data allowances up to 1TB, 1,000 outgoing mins, 1,000 SMS, unlimited free calls to 3 M1 numbers with worldwide daily roaming from $0.99 onwards.

Can I keep my existing mobile number when switching to M1 SIM-Only?

Yes, you can port over your existing mobile number from any Singapore telco to a M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plan during the online signup process free of charge.

Does M1 SIM-Only support True 5G network speeds?

Yes, all M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plans include True 5G access, providing high-speed connectivity across Singapore islandwide on 5G enabled mobile devices.

How does data roaming work on M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plans?

M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plans offer daily roaming from $0.99 across 78 destinations. Additionally, the $17.95/mth 1TB plan comes bundled with 1GB of Worldwide Roaming data.

Can I get an eSIM for M1 Bespoke SIM-Only plans?

Yes, you can opt for a FREE eSIM during checkout to activate your service instantly on compatible devices, or select a physical nano-SIM card.
